_readme: mod registry - OPTIONAL overrides for build_all_mods.ps1.
Default behavior = auto-discovery: every directory under ReposRoot that contains a *.csproj
is treated as a mod repo (repo root artifact <AssemblyName>.dll -> slot mods\<slot>\<dll>).
Use this file ONLY for exceptions:
enabled=false  -> skip build/deploy (obsolete fix, official game already fixed it).
The script still WARNS if the game slot holds a leftover dll - that dll is
just garbage, NOT an active mod: whether the GAME loads a slot is decided by
Verified 2026-10-05: the 58 'Finished mod initialization for ...' lines in
godot.log match the is_enabled=true set exactly (all 5 disabled local slots
are absent), so disabling here + deleting the slot keeps mods\ unambiguous.
slot / dll     -> override slot directory name / deployed dll file name.
Unknown repos not listed here are auto-discovered and enabled by default.
NOTE on 'enabled' semantics: it means BUILD/DEPLOY here, which is independent of the in-game
per-mod toggle. A few entries below are marked enabled=true (we keep building them) while the
game side has them switched off - see their notes.
